findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_reviews · Private data: get_vpn_config, create_wallet, check_balance, create_deposit, list_transactions, purchase_esim, list_esim_topups, purchase_esim_topup, purchase_uk_number, purchase_vpn, get_one_time_code · Public sink: get_uk_number_info, get_payment_and_delivery_times, purchase_uk_number, get_one_time_code.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_reviews · Private data: get_vpn_config, create_wallet, check_balance, create_deposit, list_transactions, purchase_esim, list_esim_topups, purchase_esim_topup, purchase_uk_number, purchase_vpn, get_one_time_code · Public sink: get_uk_number_info, get_payment_and_delivery_times, purchase_uk_number, get_one_time_code

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_deposit" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Top up the agent wallet with crypto (pass the ak_live_ api key from create_wallet). Returns a crypto payment address and amount; the balance is credited automatically once the payment confirms on-chain. Minimum $10." → after: "Top up the agent wallet with crypto (pass the ak_live_ api key from create_wallet). Returns a crypto payment address and amount; the balance is credited automatically once the payment confirms on-chain. Minimum $100."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
